factory.title: Why Order Directly from the Factory?

batch.title: No Risk of Shade Differences (Co-lot Match)
batch.text: When you order material for the whole project (e.g. 500–5000 m²), you receive goods from a single production run. We eliminate colour differences between packs.

price.title: Cost Optimisation (Factory Price)
price.text: You skip intermediary margins and warehousing costs in Poland. You get state-of-the-art SPC material at an unbeatable wholesale price.

delivery.title: Delivery Straight to the Construction Site
delivery.text: We arrange dedicated transport (FTL/LTL) directly from the factory to your project in any city in Poland.

purpose.title: Purpose and legal basis
purpose.text: We process the data from the forms to prepare and send a commercial offer, arrange a sample presentation and answer your inquiry (Art. 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR), and to establish, pursue or defend claims (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

scope.title: Scope of data
scope.text: Your full name or company name, phone number, email address and the project details you provide in the form.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.text: The data may be received by the IT service providers we use for website hosting and email delivery. If a provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, this is based on standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.text: We keep the data until you withdraw your consent or for as long as needed to prepare the offer and conduct business talks, and then for the limitation period of any claims.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to data portability, to object, and to withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. You may lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO).
